It's great for adding just a splash of color to any horse.|Inventory|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== The Extravagant Bridle is a type of [[Bridle]] that can be obtained from [[Blynne]] by completing the [[Obstacle Course]] [[Mini-Game]] in less than one minute and thirty seconds.{{Cite|If you can beat my personal best time, I'll give you some mighty fine {{Color BotW|Red|horse gear}}.|Blynne|BotW}}{{Cite|Here's that {{Color BotW|Red|horse gear}} I promised you. Keep at it, and maybe someday you'll be on my level.|Blynne|BotW}} These Bridles are often utilized in festivals. They are also decorated with feathers, making them great for adding a splash of color to [[Horse]]s. The Extravagant Bridle is a piece of [[Extravagant Gear]], which is a set of [[Horse Gear]].{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 161}} [[Link]] can have the Extravagant Bridle equipped onto his Horses by one of the workers at [[Highland Stable]], [[Outskirt Stable]], [[South Akkala Stable]], or [[Woodland Stable]].{{Cite|Change to {{Color BotW|Red|Extravagant Bridle}}?|Canni|BotW}} However, as is the case with other Bridles, they are unable be worn by [[Epona]] or the [[Giant Horse]].{{Cite|Hello there! That's a mighty find horse you have. If you like, I can change out her {{Color BotW|Blue|gear}} or maybe... Oh? Actually, this horse is different from any I've ever seen before. My, she's so lovely and graceful... I'm sorry, but I'm pretty sure this little lady would absolutely hate it if you changed her mane or gear. I'm so sorry about that.|Canni|BotW}}{{Cite|Hello there! That's a mighty find horse you have. If you like, I can change out its {{Color BotW|Blue|gear}} or maybe... Oh? My goodness, that's no pony, is it? It's so big! I'm sorry, but I don't think I have any {{Color BotW|Blue|gear}} that'd fit such a large horse, and I bet it wouldn't like its {{Color BotW|Blue|mane}} handled...
